synopsis: The UK Treasury Five Case Model structures a business case into strategic, economic, commercial, financial and management cases [f16459]. Chapter 12 includes it among practitioner formats for executive communication and recommends it as a documented template for structuring the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation plan [f9851, f9981]. Specifically, the problem and decision context section should occupy 1–2 pages, drawing on Heilmeier and the Five Case Model, while the sustainment and change policy section should occupy 0.5–1 page, drawing on the Five Case Model [f10154, f10180]. These facts establish its structure and recommended planning uses, but provide no evidence of effectiveness or mapping between the five cases and the proposed plan sections [f16459, f9981, f10154, f10180].
